KAMPALA, July 16 (Reuters) - Uganda discharged its last remaining Ebola ​patient on Thursday, triggering a 42-day countdown after ‌which it can be declared free of the virus, the East African nation's health ministry said. "Today, Uganda has discharged the last Ebola patient, a Congolese national who has successfully recovered and (is) ready to be with his family," ​Uganda's health ministry ​said in ⁠a post on X. *   About Reuters, opens new tab. *   Media Center, opens new tab. *   Reuters News Agency, opens new tab. *   #### World-Check, opens new tab.
